script: Here is something most people get wrong. The brain does not store a memory in one place. It rebuilds it every single time you remember it.

Mike.transcript: Surprisingly, this happens because your brain sometimes treats walking through a doorway as the beginning of a new event. That change can interrupt your short-term memory, making you forget what you were thinking about just seconds earlier.
